summary: Blue Owl Capital Inc. filed an 8-K reporting routine quarterly results and a regular cash dividend. The filing covers Item 2.02 (earnings release and presentation) and Item 8.01 (dividend of $0.23 per Class A share payable August 27, 2026). No special-situation event such as M&A, restructuring, or activist activity is present. The dividend is a standard capital return to shareholders but does not qualify as an extraordinary capital return special situation.
